source_data.desc:
_These twitching balls of tentacles surround an inhuman face dominated by a squid-like beak._  
**Servants of the Void.** The dorreqi are servants to ancient horrors of the void and realms beyond human understanding. They are guardians and sentries for such creatures, and they swarm and attack any creatures approaching too close to the elder aberrations they serve.  
**Death from Above.** Dorreq prefer to drop on their victims from above, pinning them in a grapple attack with their many tentacles and biting them with their large chitinous beaks.
source_data.name: Dorreq
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Innate Spellcasting", "desc": "The dorreq's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 10). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 3/day each: blink, dimension door, haste, shatter Wasteland Stride. This ability works like tree stride, but the dorreq can use it to sink into and appear out of any sandy or rocky ground, and the range is only 30 ft. Using this ability replaces the dorreq's usual movement."}]

en.description:
_These twitching balls of tentacles surround an inhuman face dominated by a squid-like beak._  
**Servants of the Void.** The dorreqi are servants to ancient horrors of the void and realms beyond human understanding. They are guardians and sentries for such creatures, and they swarm and attack any creatures approaching too close to the elder aberrations they serve.  
**Death from Above.** Dorreq prefer to drop on their victims from above, pinning them in a grapple attack with their many tentacles and biting them with their large chitinous beaks.
en.name: Dorreq

ru.description:
Эти дёргающиеся шары щупалец окружают нечеловеческое лицо, доминируемое клювом, похожим на клюв кальмара.

**Слуги Пустоты.** Дорреки — слуги древних ужасов пустоты и царств за пределами человеческого понимания. Они — стражи и часовые для таких существ, и они роятся и атакуют любых существ, приближающихся слишком близко к древним аберрациям, которым они служат.

**Смерть сверху.** Дорреки предпочитают падать на своих жертв сверху, пригвождая их в захватной атаке своими многими щупальцами и кусая их своими большими хитиновыми клювами.
ru.name: Доррек
